title: Discovery of new DHA ethanolamine derivatives as potential anti-inflammatory agents targeting Nur77.
authors: Fang, Hua; Li, Mengyu; Wang, Xiumei; Chen, Weizhu; He, Fengming; Zhang, Yiping; Guo, Kaiqiang; Jin, Wenhui; Li, Baicun; Fang, Meijuan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究DHA乙醇胺衍生物作为抗炎剂靶向Nur77，虽涉及分子对接但核心是药物化学与湿实验，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Docosahexaenoic acid (DHA) has a strong anti-inflammatory effect and is reported to bind to the ligand-binding domain (LBD) of the anti-inflammatory modulator Nur77. Recently, we have found that DHA ethanolamine (DHA-EA) exerts anti-inflammatory activity as a Nur77 modulator. Herein, using a fragment splicing-based drug design strategy, nineteen new DHA-EA derivatives were synthesized starting from DHA algae oil and then evaluated for their anti-inflammatory activity. The cell-based cytotoxicity assays showed that compounds J2, J9, and J18 had no noticeable effect on the cell morphology and viability of RAW 264.7, LO2, and MCR-5 cells. Meanwhile, J9 was identified as the most potent anti-inflammatory molecule in LPS-stimulated RAW 264.7 cells. Also, the molecular docking study and SPR assay demonstrated that J9 exhibited in vitro Nur77-binding affinity (K(D) = 8.58 x 10(-6) M). Moreover, the mechanism studies revealed that the anti-inflammatory activity of J9 was associated with its inhibition of NF-kappaB activation in a Nur77-dependent manner. Notably, J9 could attenuate LPS-induced inflammation in the mouse acute lung injury (ALI) model. Overall, the DHA-EA derivative J9 targeting Nur77 is a potential candidate for developing anti-inflammatory and ALI-treating agents.
abstract_zh: 二十二碳六烯酸（DHA）具有强效的抗炎作用，并据报道能与抗炎调节因子Nur77的配体结合域（LBD）结合。近期，我们发现DHA乙醇胺（DHA-EA）作为Nur77调节剂发挥抗炎活性。在此，采用基于片段拼接的药物设计策略，以DHA藻油为起始原料合成了十九种新的DHA-EA衍生物，并评估了其抗炎活性。基于细胞的细胞毒性实验表明，化合物J2、J9和J18对RAW 264.7、LO2和MCR-5细胞的形态和活力无明显影响。同时，在脂多糖（LPS）刺激的RAW 264.7细胞中，J9被鉴定为最具潜力的抗炎分子。此外，分子对接研究和表面等离子体共振（SPR）实验表明，J9在体外表现出Nur77结合亲和力（K(D) = 8.58 x 10(-6) M）。进一步，机制研究揭示J9的抗炎活性与其以Nur77依赖性方式抑制NF-kappaB激活相关。值得注意的是，J9在小鼠急性肺损伤（ALI）模型中能够减轻LPS诱导的炎症。总体而言，靶向Nur77的DHA-EA衍生物J9是开发抗炎和ALI治疗药物的潜在候选化合物。
